newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal's Lisnave hits high for '97.
newsitem.headline: Portugal's Lisnave hits high for '97.

text.p: Shares of Portuguese ship repairer Lisnave-Estaleiros Navais de Lisboa SA hit a new high for the year of 746 escudos on Lisbon bourse as private investors snapped up the stock, dealers said.
"More than 80 percent of the trades done so far today were buy orders by private investors," said one operator.

A dealer said: "The rise of Lisnave is very speculative. People are beginning to talk of a share price of 1,000 escudos for Lisnave after the recent news about its restructuring, but I doubt it will reach 800 escudos."
Lisnave later eased back to 688 escudos, up 93, in volume of 396,366 shares at 1044 GMT.
Under the restructuring, Lisnave's operations will be divided into a new ship repairing unit and another company that will seek jobs for its excess labour.
